group.ja: 最適化・確率・逆問題

summary.ja: Bratuの合成観測から係数を推定し、2パラメータの随伴勾配、正則化の偏り、観測感度の特異値と識別不能例を検証する。 追加固定例：GN・LMと有界最小二乗のBratu比較、既知最小点でのBFGSと3組L-BFGS、雑音・モデル差と有限γ経路の正則化。条件と検証範囲は各配布版で確認してください。
summary.en: Fit Bratu coefficients from synthetic observations and verify two-parameter adjoint gradients, regularization bias, data-sensitivity singular values and nonidentifiable observations. Additional fixed examples: Bratu comparisons of GN, LM and bounded least squares, BFGS and three-pair L-BFGS at known minima, Noise, model discrepancy and finite gamma paths. See each release for assumptions and checked scope.

references.label: A new approach to variable metric algorithms (1970)
references.scope: Method-specific source; see the detailed reading for source role and actual review depth.

references.label: Minimization of functions having Lipschitz continuous first partial derivatives (1966)
references.scope: Original sufficient-decrease and backtracking construction; the detailed chapter distinguishes the local projected implementation from the original theorem.

references.label: Regularization Tools, Version 4.1 manual (March 2008)
references.scope: Author official manual; the detailed chapter records the selected SVD and standard-form Tikhonov/nonzero-prior passages consulted. The local Bratu implementation is independent of the MATLAB toolbox.

assumptions: Smooth lower-branch Bratu states on a fixed mesh with a locally nonsingular state Jacobian and fixed zero Dirichlet data.
The new spatial coefficient is lambda(x)=a+b(2x-1), with a in [1,2.8] and b in [-0.5,0.5]; this extends the earlier constant-lambda model.
Fixed synthetic observations, positive weights and explicitly stated parameter scales, priors and regularization strengths; data-only sensitivity rank is separate from a regularized system rank.
units: Dimensionless state, coordinate and coefficients. Observation weights and parameter scales are explicit; singular values and regularization strengths depend on those scales.
boundary_conditions: u(0)=u(1)=0 independent of both coefficients; fixed observation locations on [0,1].

next_deliverable.ja: データに基づく正則化強度の選択、多数係数、実測データ、より一般的な最適化法の独立検証。
next_deliverable.en: Separate validation for data-driven regularization selection, many coefficients, real data and more general optimization methods.

limitations.ja: 小規模な滑らかなBratu下側分枝と固定合成観測による教育用検証。2パラメータ空間係数の推定、Tikhonov正則化、局所的なデータ感度のSVD、中央観測の階数不足と反射対称性による曖昧さを扱う。正則化による事前値の選択を観測情報の増加と解釈しない。実測データ、多数係数の関数推定、大域的一意性、統計的信頼区間、準Newton法全般は検証しない。 上記の制限は既存配布版の範囲です。今回の追加配布版：小さい滑らかな分枝の局所比較。SciPy最適化ライブラリは参照側でも共有し、大域最小・一意性を証明しません。LMに箱制約があるとは説明しません。 厳密線形探索ではないためn反復終了や一般的Rosenbrock大域収束を主張しません。原著選択箇所は弱Wolfeであり、本例のstrong Wolfeと区別。Fletcher1970本文は未読です。 楕円は選択γを固定した局所Gauss–Newton線形モデルのplug-inです。非線形残差の二階微分、γ選択のランダム性、選択事象で条件づけた共分散、事後分布、被覆率を扱いません。全γ連続経路・実測データも未検証。
limitations.en: Educational tests use small smooth lower-branch Bratu problems and fixed synthetic observations. They cover two spatial coefficients, Tikhonov regularization, local data-sensitivity SVD, rank loss with central observations and reflection ambiguity. Prior selection through regularization does not add observational information. Real data, high-dimensional function estimation, global uniqueness, statistical confidence intervals and quasi-Newton methods generally are outside scope. The preceding limitations describe earlier editions. This additional release: A local comparison on a small smooth branch. The optimizer library is shared by the reference and a companion; no global minimum or uniqueness proof is claimed. LM is not presented as a box-constrained method. No exact n-step termination or general global convergence on Rosenbrock is claimed. The selected original text uses weak Wolfe, distinct from this study’s strong Wolfe policy. Fletcher’s 1970 original article remains unread. Ellipses are plug-in noise propagation for a local Gauss–Newton linear model with the selected gamma treated as fixed. They omit nonlinear residual Hessians and selection randomness and are not selection-conditional covariance, a posterior or a coverage guarantee. Continuous gamma paths and real data remain unverified.

合成観測と正の重みを固定し、パラメータの尺度・事前値・正則化強度を明記する。データだけの感度行列の階数と、正則化後の系の階数を区別する。

title.ja: GN・LMと有界最小二乗のBratu比較
title.en: Bratu comparisons of GN, LM and bounded least squares

summary.ja: 同じ観測からの17固定fitで、変数尺度・重み・境界と物理座標の停止条件を分けます。
summary.en: Seventeen fixed fits separate parameter scaling, weights, bounds and physical-coordinate stopping conditions.

assumptions.ja: 無次元1D Bratu、31内点、u(0)=u(1)=0。既存の2係数モデルと保存済み観測を再利用。正則化γとLM減衰μを別に扱います。
assumptions.en: A dimensionless one-dimensional Bratu problem with 31 interior nodes and zero Dirichlet data. The existing two-coefficient extension and saved observations are reused; objective regularization gamma and LM damping mu are distinct.

algorithm.ja: 独自SVD最小二乗GN/LM、元の投影勾配、SciPy TRF、非有界SciPy LM。lower/upperベクトルを元PGの係数別区間へ明示変換。
algorithm.en: Original SVD least-squares GN/LM, the retained projected-gradient solver, SciPy TRF and explicitly unbounded SciPy LM. A canonical lower/upper box is explicitly adapted to the legacy per-parameter intervals.

validation.ja: 独立Thomas状態・感度と4局所参照fit。最終状態残差、物理勾配または投影勾配、目的値差、データのみのSVD、活性境界を検査。非有界法の共通参照は内点かつ非有界停留が条件です。
validation.en: Independent Thomas states/sensitivities and four local reference fits. Gate final state residuals, physical gradient or projected gradient, objective gaps, data-only SVD and active bounds. Common references for unbounded methods must be strictly interior and unbounded-stationary.

limits.ja: 小さい滑らかな分枝の局所比較。SciPy最適化ライブラリは参照側でも共有し、大域最小・一意性を証明しません。LMに箱制約があるとは説明しません。
limits.en: A local comparison on a small smooth branch. The optimizer library is shared by the reference and a companion; no global minimum or uniqueness proof is claimed. LM is not presented as a box-constrained method.

title.en: BFGS and three-pair L-BFGS at known minima

summary.ja: 8次元SPD二次関数と3初期値のRosenbrockを用い、曲率・strong Wolfe・現在の有限記憶作用を検査します。
summary.en: An eight-dimensional SPD quadratic and three Rosenbrock starts test curvature, strong Wolfe conditions and the current finite-memory action.

assumptions.ja: 無次元の非有界代数的最適化。既知の解析最小点を持ち、物理PDEの境界条件はありません。
assumptions.en: Dimensionless unconstrained algebraic optimization with known analytic minima; there is no physical PDE boundary condition.

algorithm.ja: 独自逆BFGSとベクトルだけの2-loop L-BFGS（3組）。独立な小稠密oracleは現在γ₀Iから現在保持する組だけを古い順に再生。SciPy BFGS/L-BFGS-B（bounds=None）を別実装として比較。
algorithm.en: Original inverse-BFGS and vector-only two-loop L-BFGS with three pairs. A separate small dense oracle replays only currently retained pairs from the current gamma0 I. SciPy BFGS and unbounded L-BFGS-B are distinct software companions.

validation.ja: 16固定fit、解析的な最小点・勾配、各受理stepのstrong Wolfeと解像された正曲率、BFGSの対称SPD、L-BFGS作用差を判定。保持組とoracle稠密行列の記憶を分離。
validation.en: Sixteen fixed fits check analytic minima/gradients, strong Wolfe and resolved positive curvature at every accepted step, symmetric SPD BFGS matrices and L-BFGS action defects. Retained-pair and dense-oracle storage are reported separately.

limits.ja: 厳密線形探索ではないためn反復終了や一般的Rosenbrock大域収束を主張しません。原著選択箇所は弱Wolfeであり、本例のstrong Wolfeと区別。Fletcher1970本文は未読です。
limits.en: No exact n-step termination or general global convergence on Rosenbrock is claimed. The selected original text uses weak Wolfe, distinct from this study’s strong Wolfe policy. Fletcher’s 1970 original article remains unread.

title.ja: 雑音・モデル差と有限γ経路の正則化
title.en: Noise, model discrepancy and finite gamma paths

summary.ja: 2独立ノイズベクトルを尺度・データ文脈で共有し、42固定fitから有限γ選択と固定γの局所共分散を分けます。
summary.en: Two independent noise vectors are reused across scales and data contexts. Forty-two fixed fits separate finite-list gamma selection from fixed-gamma local covariance.

assumptions.ja: Bratu推定は31内点、5観測、W=I/5、Σ=σ²I。既存1023格子のデータは保存値を使い再生成しません。σ=1e-4/1e-3、seed67001/67002、γの固定5点です。
assumptions.en: Bratu inference uses 31 interior nodes, five observations, W=I/5 and Sigma=sigma² I. Existing 1023-grid observations are reused without regeneration. Fixed sigma values are 1e-4/1e-3, seeds are 67001/67002 and the gamma list has five entries.

algorithm.ja: 全γのfitを資格した完全経路だけから、実現雑音ノルムの1.05倍を満たす最大γを選択。不完全経路と完全だが候補なしを分離。4点L-curveは記述診断。
algorithm.en: Select the largest admissible gamma using 1.05 times the realized noise norm only after the full gamma path qualifies. Incomplete paths and complete paths with no admissible gamma are distinct. Four-point L-curves are descriptive diagnostics.

validation.ja: 42 fitの最終残差・物理KKT・実行完了、選択規則、明示的2×2代数による固定線形モデルの共分散・偏り・モデル差応答、対称PSDを検査。
validation.en: Gate final residuals, physical KKT conditions and completion for all 42 fits, the selection rule, and covariance/bias/model-shift response against explicit scalar 2x2 algebra, including symmetry and PSD.

limits.ja: 楕円は選択γを固定した局所Gauss–Newton線形モデルのplug-inです。非線形残差の二階微分、γ選択のランダム性、選択事象で条件づけた共分散、事後分布、被覆率を扱いません。全γ連続経路・実測データも未検証。
limits.en: Ellipses are plug-in noise propagation for a local Gauss–Newton linear model with the selected gamma treated as fixed. They omit nonlinear residual Hessians and selection randomness and are not selection-conditional covariance, a posterior or a coverage guarantee. Continuous gamma paths and real data remain unverified.

references.review_scope: Official author manual: selected text around Section 2.5 and Section 2.9; physical pages 20 and 37 (printed 18 and 35) rendered locally and visually inspected. Four-point chord curvature here is a finite-list diagnostic, not the manual spline/corner algorithm, a theorem of optimal regularization or coverage. Original software (1994) and later article (2007) are separate bibliographic works and were not read.

name.en: Noise, model discrepancy and finite gamma paths

scope.ja: 2独立ノイズベクトルを尺度・データ文脈で共有し、42固定fitから有限γ選択と固定γの局所共分散を分けます。
scope.en: Two independent noise vectors are reused across scales and data contexts. Forty-two fixed fits separate finite-list gamma selection from fixed-gamma local covariance.

method_note.ja: 全γのfitを資格した完全経路だけから、実現雑音ノルムの1.05倍を満たす最大γを選択。不完全経路と完全だが候補なしを分離。4点L-curveは記述診断。
method_note.en: Select the largest admissible gamma using 1.05 times the realized noise norm only after the full gamma path qualifies. Incomplete paths and complete paths with no admissible gamma are distinct. Four-point L-curves are descriptive diagnostics.

note.en: No exact n-step termination or general global convergence on Rosenbrock is claimed. The selected original text uses weak Wolfe, distinct from this study’s strong Wolfe policy. Fletcher’s 1970 original article remains unread.

note.ja: 楕円は選択γを固定した局所Gauss–Newton線形モデルのplug-inです。非線形残差の二階微分、γ選択のランダム性、選択事象で条件づけた共分散、事後分布、被覆率を扱いません。全γ連続経路・実測データも未検証。
note.en: Ellipses are plug-in noise propagation for a local Gauss–Newton linear model with the selected gamma treated as fixed. They omit nonlinear residual Hessians and selection randomness and are not selection-conditional covariance, a posterior or a coverage guarantee. Continuous gamma paths and real data remain unverified.
